sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "surah_metadata" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "surah_number" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "official_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "ayah_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NULL, "source_version" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (surah_number > 0), CHECK (ayah_count > 0), CHECK (length(official_name) > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mastered_surahs" ("surah_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES surah_metadata (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "is_currently_mastered" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_currently_mastered" IN (0, 1)), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "has_entered_rotation" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_entered_rotation" IN (0, 1)), "activation_baseline_score" INTEGER NULL, "cached_rotation_score" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cached_total_recitations" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cached_last_used_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "alias" TEXT NULL, "display_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("surah_id"), CHECK (activation_baseline_score IS NULL OR activation_baseline_score >= 0), CHECK (cached_rotation_score >= 0), CHECK (cached_total_recitations >= 0), CHECK (has_entered_rotation = 1 OR is_active = 0), CHECK (is_currently_mastered = 1 OR is_active = 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rotation_states" ("singleton_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "rotation_target" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "last_journal_sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "projection_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("singleton_id"), CHECK (singleton_id = 1), CHECK (rotation_target >= 1), CHECK (last_journal_sequence >= 0), CHECK (projection_version > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rotation_schemes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "surah_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mastered_surahs (surah_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ayah_count_snapshot" INTEGER NOT NULL, "baseline_score" INTEGER NOT NULL, "baseline_total_recitations" INTEGER NOT NULL, "baseline_last_used_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "resets_rotation_baseline" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("resets_rotation_baseline" IN (0, 1)), "activated_journal_sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "superseded_journal_sequence" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("surah_id", "version"), UNIQUE ("id", "surah_id"), CHECK (length(id) > 0), CHECK (version > 0), CHECK (ayah_count_snapshot > 0), CHECK (baseline_score >= 0), CHECK (baseline_total_recitations >= 0), CHECK (activated_journal_sequence >= 0), CHECK (superseded_journal_sequence IS NULL OR superseded_journal_sequence >= activated_journal_sequence));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rotation_parts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "scheme_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rotation_schemes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cached_score" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cached_recitation_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cached_last_used_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("scheme_id", "ordinal"), UNIQUE ("id", "scheme_id"), CHECK (length(id) > 0), CHECK (ordinal >= 1), CHECK (start_ayah > 0), CHECK (end_ayah >= start_ayah), CHECK (cached_score >= 0), CHECK (cached_recitation_count >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "prayer_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "prayer_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_qada" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_qada" IN (0, 1)), "started_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (prayer_type IN ('fajr', 'dhuhr', 'asr', 'maghrib', 'isha', 'jumuah', 'witr', 'nafl')), CHECK (is_qada = 0 OR prayer_type NOT IN ('nafl', 'jumuah')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "prayer_routine_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "prayer_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (prayer_type), CHECK (length(display_name) > 0), CHECK (revision > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "prayer_routine_part_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "routine_template_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES prayer_routine_templates (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "stable_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "custom_label" TEXT NULL, "rakaat_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "required_surah_slots" INTEGER NOT NULL, "allows_following_imam" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("allows_following_imam" IN (0, 1)), "default_completion_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'recitations', PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (routine_template_id, stable_key), UNIQUE (routine_template_id, order_index), CHECK (order_index >= 0), CHECK (kind IN ('fard', 'sunnah', 'witr', 'nafl', 'custom')), CHECK (kind != 'custom' OR length(custom_label) > 0), CHECK (rakaat_count > 0), CHECK (required_surah_slots >= 0), CHECK (default_completion_mode IN ('recitations', 'followedImam')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "prayer_session_parts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "prayer_session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES prayer_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "source_template_part_id" TEXT NULL, "template_revision" INTEGER NULL, "stable_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "rakaat_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "required_surah_slots" INTEGER NOT NULL, "allows_following_imam" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("allows_following_imam" IN (0, 1)), "completion_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'recitations', "completed_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (prayer_session_id, order_index), CHECK (order_index >= 0), CHECK (length(label) > 0), CHECK (kind IN ('fard', 'sunnah', 'witr', 'nafl', 'custom')), CHECK (rakaat_count > 0), CHECK (required_surah_slots >= 0), CHECK (completion_mode IN ('recitations', 'followedImam')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recitation_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "journal_sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "surah_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mastered_surahs (surah_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "rotation_scheme_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rakaat_span_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "prayer_session_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES prayer_sessions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "prayer_session_part_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES prayer_session_parts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "slot_index" INTEGER NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "prayer_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_qada" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_qada" IN (0, 1)), "qada_origin_is_unknown" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("qada_origin_is_unknown" IN (0, 1)), "qada_fulfilled_local_date" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("id", "rotation_scheme_id"), CHECK (length(id) > 0), CHECK (journal_sequence > 0), CHECK (prayer_type IN ('fajr', 'dhuhr', 'asr', 'maghrib', 'isha', 'jumuah', 'witr', 'nafl')), CHECK (is_qada = 0 OR prayer_type NOT IN ('nafl', 'jumuah')), CHECK (rakaat_span_count >= 1), CHECK (slot_index IS NULL OR slot_index >= 0), CHECK (qada_origin_is_unknown = 0 OR is_qada = 1), CHECK (qada_fulfilled_local_date IS NULL OR is_qada = 1), FOREIGN KEY (rotation_scheme_id, surah_id) REFERENCES rotation_schemes (id, surah_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recitation_event_parts" ("event_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "scheme_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "part_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("event_id", "part_id"), FOREIGN KEY (event_id, scheme_id) REFERENCES recitation_events (id, rotation_scheme_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (part_id, scheme_id) REFERENCES rotation_parts (id, scheme_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rotation_adjustments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "journal_sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "surah_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mastered_surahs (surah_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "rotation_scheme_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "delta" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(id) > 0), CHECK (journal_sequence > 0), CHECK (delta != 0), CHECK (length(reason) > 0), FOREIGN KEY (rotation_scheme_id, surah_id) REFERENCES rotation_schemes (id, surah_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "learning_surahs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "surah_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES surah_metadata (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "ayah_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "plan_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'classicCumulative', "stage_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "stage_start_ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stage_end_ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_start_ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_end_ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "block_size" INTEGER NULL, "learning_cycle" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_learning_activity_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "inactivity_rollback_for_activity_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (ayah_count > 0), CHECK (target_start_ayah > 0 AND target_end_ayah >= target_start_ayah AND target_end_ayah <= ayah_count), CHECK (stage_start_ayah >= target_start_ayah AND stage_end_ayah >= stage_start_ayah AND stage_end_ayah <= target_end_ayah), CHECK (plan_kind IN ('classicCumulative', 'chunked')), CHECK (stage_kind IN ('newAyah', 'cumulative', 'reviewRange', 'bridge', 'sectionReview', 'finalReview')), CHECK (block_size IS NULL OR block_size > 0), CHECK (plan_kind = 'chunked' OR block_size IS NULL), CHECK (plan_kind = 'classicCumulative' OR block_size IS NOT NULL), CHECK (learning_cycle > 0), CHECK (status IN ('active', 'completed')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "learning_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "learning_surah_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES learning_surahs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "learning_cycle" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "from_plan_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "from_target_start_ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "from_target_end_ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "from_block_size" INTEGER NULL, "from_stage_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "from_stage_start_ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "from_stage_end_ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "to_plan_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_target_start_ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "to_target_end_ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "to_block_size" INTEGER NULL, "to_stage_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_stage_start_ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "to_stage_end_ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("id"), CHECK (length(id) > 0), CHECK (type IN ('repeated', 'learned', 'inactivityRollback', 'completed', 'restarted', 'planChanged')), CHECK (learning_cycle > 0), CHECK (from_plan_kind IN ('classicCumulative', 'chunked')), CHECK (to_plan_kind IN ('classicCumulative', 'chunked')), CHECK (from_target_start_ayah > 0 AND from_target_end_ayah >= from_target_start_ayah), CHECK (to_target_start_ayah > 0 AND to_target_end_ayah >= to_target_start_ayah), CHECK (from_plan_kind = 'chunked' OR from_block_size IS NULL), CHECK (to_plan_kind = 'chunked' OR to_block_size IS NULL), CHECK (from_plan_kind = 'classicCumulative' OR from_block_size IS NOT NULL), CHECK (to_plan_kind = 'classicCumulative' OR to_block_size IS NOT NULL), CHECK (from_stage_kind IN ('newAyah', 'cumulative', 'reviewRange', 'bridge', 'sectionReview', 'finalReview')), CHECK (to_stage_kind IN ('newAyah', 'cumulative', 'reviewRange', 'bridge', 'sectionReview', 'finalReview')), CHECK (from_stage_start_ayah > 0 AND from_stage_end_ayah >= from_stage_start_ayah), CHECK (to_stage_start_ayah > 0 AND to_stage_end_ayah >= to_stage_start_ayah), CHECK (reason IS NULL OR length(reason) > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recall_attempts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "surah_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES surah_metadata (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "ayah_start" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ayah_end" INTEGER NOT NULL, "learning_cycle" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "result" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("id"), CHECK (length(id) > 0), CHECK (ayah_start > 0), CHECK (ayah_end >= ayah_start), CHECK (learning_cycle > 0), CHECK (result IN ('recalled', 'recalledWithMistake', 'notRecalled')), CHECK (source IN ('learning', 'surah')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"), CHECK (value_type IN ('string', 'bool', 'int', 'double')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox_entries" ("owner_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "envelope_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_tombstone" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_tombstone" IN (0, 1)), "enqueued_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "envelope_updated_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_failure_reason" TEXT NULL, "envelope_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_key", "envelope_id"), CHECK (length(owner_key) > 0), CHECK (length(envelope_id) > 0), CHECK (length(entity_key) > 0), CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'quarantined')), CHECK (attempt_count >= 0), CHECK (last_failure_reason IS NULL OR length(last_failure_reason) > 0), CHECK (length(envelope_json) > 0));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_cursors" ("owner_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "pull_cursor" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_key"), CHECK (length(owner_key) > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_activations" ("owner_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "choice" TEXT NULL, "backup_id" TEXT NULL, "decided_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "last_success_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_key"), CHECK (length(owner_key) > 0), CHECK (choice IS NULL OR choice IN ('merge', 'keepDeviceLocalOnly')), CHECK (is_active = 0 OR choice = 'merge'), CHECK (choice IS NULL OR decided_at_utc IS NOT NULL));
